name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.83: fridge basket editor refinements. Product search suggestions now show a thumbnail, name and catalog price (matching the coil swap list). Selecting a product autofills the catalog retail price and weight into the editor (both still overridable). The per-basket tolerance field is removed from the UI and no longer operator-set; tolerance stays hardcoded at the 15g sensor-noise default in the config builder to avoid misconfiguration. Cumulative over v5.82.
